meta.title: SCIM 2.0 (HRMS Sync): on failure — admin dashboard shows sync errors
gaps: Configure the SCIM 2.0 HRMS Sync integration with the specified parameters and bearer-token authentication
Make the external SCIM service fail or become unreachable
Trigger the SCIM sync through an HRMS user create, update, or deprovision event
Verify the admin dashboard shows the sync error, alert, log, or retry record and that the failure was not silently dropped
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the SCIM 2.0 HRMS Sync integration with the specified parameters and bearer-token authentication; Make the external SCIM service fail or become unreachable; Trigger the SCIM sync through an HRMS user create, update, or deprovision event; Verify the admin dashboard shows the sync error, alert, log, or retry record and that the failure was not silently dropped

args.need: configure the SCIM 2.0 HRMS Sync integration, make the external service fail or become unreachable, trigger an HRMS user create/update/deprovision event, and leave the admin dashboard open showing the resulting sync error or retry record

steps.note: The catalog has no SCIM integration, HRMS trigger, external-service failure, or admin-dashboard error-observation step.
Check the tester-prepared dashboard for visible evidence of the expected synchronization failure; the exact dashboard label is not defined by the catalog.
